Method of Attack: Encrypts files on QNAP NAS devices and appends .encrypt extension
Demands ransom payment via Tor payment site
Exploits known vulnerabilities and brute-forces weak passwords
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2018-19943, CVE-2018-19949, CVE-2018-19953 vulnerabilities
Brute-forcing weak passwords on QNAP devices
Indicators of Compromise: Strangely named QNAP apps in AppCenter
Tor payment site link demanding approximately $500
